result.description: Tool output text; empty string allowed when error is set.

parts.description: Multimodal outcome parts; present only when the call returned non-text content.

error.description: Structured tool error; present only when the call failed.

outcome.description: Typed failure classification; present only when the call failed with a classified outcome (NUDGE-DESIGN §4).

reason.description: Typed failure reason vocabulary; present only together with outcome.

effects.description: Declared side-effect state of the failed invocation; present only together with outcome.
